title: New Flow Pack formats for prevention campaigns
excerpt: We have expanded Flow Pack variants with options for gel, Sexydam and female condoms, ready for your branding.
body:
Gautex Medica has added new Flow Pack variants designed for public health campaigns and corporate events.

Available formats include male condoms, single-dose lubricant gels, Sexydam and female condoms, all customisable with full-colour artwork.

Contact our sales team for samples and a quote based on quantity and delivery times.

title: ISO 13485:2016 certification renewed
excerpt: Our quality management system has passed audit by Notified Body SGS (0120).
body:
GAUTEX MÉDICA S.L. has renewed ISO 13485:2016 certification following audit by Notified Body No. 0120 (SGS).

This certification ensures compliance with requirements for medical devices manufactured and marketed by Gautex, including condoms, gels and hospital gynaecology products, together with ISO 9001 and CE marking under MDR 2017/745.

Visit our Quality page for more on certifications and traceability.

title: Updated prevention catalogue for pharmacy
excerpt: Matrix Condoms, Viva Condoms and Max Gel with new pack sizes for pharmaceutical distribution.
body:
We present the updated prevention catalogue for pharmacies and parapharmacies.

Highlights include Matrix Condoms and Viva Condoms in 144-unit boxes, plus Max Gel lubricants in 3.5 ml and 6 ml single-dose formats.

Request a B2B quote if you need trade pricing for your business.

title: CE traceability in medical products: regulatory essentials
excerpt: Key points on CE marking, Notified Body 0120 and documentation your pharmacy or distributor should request.
body:
Marketing medical devices in the European Union requires compliance with Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) and full batch traceability.

At Gautex Medica we operate under an ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001 management system audited by Notified Body No. 0120 (SGS), with controls on receipt, storage and distribution.

See our product datasheets and Quality page for more information.

title: Prevention campaigns for public entities
excerpt: Custom cases, PVC sleeves and flow packs for councils, hospitals and public health programmes.
body:
Prevention campaigns need visible, useful material bearing the promoting institution's branding.

Gautex offers custom cases, PVC sleeves, full-colour foil condoms and flow packs in multiple variants.

Use our online configurator to request a no-obligation quote within 24–48 business hours.
